title: ONNX-EdgeIDS: A Lightweight Two-Stage Edge Serving Toolkit for Network Intrusion Detection
description:
ONNX-EdgeIDS is research software for deploying machine-learning network intrusion detection on resource-constrained edge devices. It provides Kafka and ZeroMQ replay for CICIDS2017-derived flow records, a first-stage anomaly gate that filters high-volume traffic, and a second-stage tree-ensemble classifier served by ONNX Runtime or by a dependency-minimal NumPy engine exported from the same ONNX graph, together with a release gate that checks the two runtimes agree before deployment.

This release adds research results; the serving toolkit (ONNX Runtime backend, NumPy engine, exporter, release gate and artifacts) is unchanged since 0.7.0. The research/ directory gains Leafparity and the data-free probes compared on the same converter faults written into ONNX graphs (whole-graph, single-node, coupled and multi-node), a 337-fault benchmark with fault model, provenance and per-check outcomes, a day-by-day evaluation over CSE-CIC-IDS2018 separating runtime parity from detection, a batch-size sweep of the classifier backends on a Jetson board with latency, CPU, memory and idle-subtracted energy, and four real converter defects open in the latest onnxmltools and skl2onnx releases checked against their fixes.
